question: Where is Al-Yasa mentioned in the Quran?
answer: Al-Yasa is mentioned by name 2 times in 2 ayahs of the Quran.
name: Al-Yasa

evidence.ar: وَإِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَيُونُسَ وَلُوطٗاۚ وَكُلّٗا فَضَّلۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
evidence.en: And Ishmael and Elisha and Jonah and Lot - and all [of them] We preferred over the worlds.
evidence.de: und lsma’il, Alyasa’, Yunus und Lut: jeden (von ihnen) haben Wir vor den (anderen) Weltenbewohnern bevorzugt;

evidence.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ وَكُلّٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
evidence.en: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
evidence.de: Und gedenke Isma’ils, Alyasa’s und Du ’-Kifls. Alle gehören zu den Besten.
